name: remote-shell
description: Remote commands and file transfer over reusable WinRM and SSH connections.

interface.longDescription: Run commands, write or edit remote files, and transfer paths on Windows or Linux hosts while the plugin saves credentials, reuses connections, and recovers from disconnects.
defaultPrompt: Connect to a Windows or Linux host and save its credentials.
Run commands while reusing and restoring the connection automatically.
Write, edit, upload, or download files.
